text: Registered Q1 from the user-approved 2026-11-10 verifier epic at baseline 947fbe658ebb2efe993900b672ded51d5610dbcb, rule-set revision 5. Scope: Make contract-first authoring executable. Planning only: no implementation, run, seal or pass receipt is asserted. Evidence location: solve/quests/contract-first-authoring-and-producer-fidelity/evidence/receipt.json. Establish a real measuring red probe before start; the epic owns sequencing and current coordination.

Amended this unsealed proposal after the user-supplied independent review: The independent review exposed losses of authority, identity and scope across real producers. The existing transition record must trace subject/domain, authority, row-set completeness, causal position, incarnation, retained obligation and deployment binding through every hop. Add concrete domain distinctions at the selected typed boundary without inventing a universal wrapper/framework. Paired witnesses include the real latency tree, cache merge plus lifecycle payload, actual ingress and final benchmark claim admission; shape-correct doubles that omit these behaviors are insufficient. No prior finding, seal or receipt is rewritten; the new obligations are unexecuted.
